known_limitations: Bundled mode runs the SearXNG build installed by packaging/searxng/install.sh, in a separate environment. Its integrity comes from that script (pinned commit and hash-locked dependencies), and the provider checks the recorded commit at startup. Its files are not individually listed here because their location is configured.
Bundled mode needs unprivileged user and network namespaces; without them the provider is unavailable.
An external instance's own upstream traffic is outside Grenslan's control.
